verdict.oneLineSummary: Fast for your own workspace, but multi-tenant public distribution has a ~10-week App Directory review queue.

twoClocks.anyUserCanConnect: 8–10 weeks (Slack App Directory verification required for multi-org install)

cost: Free to register. Compliance, privacy auditing, and developer support infrastructure required.

capabilityCheck.question: Can an agent monitor channels and direct messages without manual user invitation?
capabilityCheck.detail: Slack bots can ONLY read channels, threads, and mentions where the bot has been explicitly invited. A bot cannot silently monitor workspace channels or read direct messages without specialized user token scopes (im:read, groups:history) that trigger severe App Directory auditing and enterprise admin scrutiny.
capabilityCheck.warningCallout: Agents cannot passively monitor Slack without explicit channel-by-channel invites (/invite @bot) by a human member.

prerequisites: A Slack development workspace with admin permissions
5+ active external Slack workspaces installed prior to App Directory submission
A public privacy policy, support URL, and detailed setup walkthrough video

steps.text: Go to api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From scratch.

fields.name: Pick a workspace to develop your app in

steps.text: Configure Bot Token Scopes under 'OAuth & Permissions'.

fields.name: Scopes → Bot Token Scopes
fields.note: CRITICAL: Plan all scopes up front. Adding any new scope later restarts Slack's 10-week review queue.

steps.text: Install to Workspace for instant local development.
steps.note: Generates a Bot User OAuth Token (`xoxb-...`) that works immediately in your dev workspace.

fields.name: Remove Hardcoded Information
fields.note: Must ensure client secrets and bot tokens are not baked into code.

fields.name: Submit to App Directory
fields.note: Requires active installations in at least 5 different external workspaces before the submit button unlocks.

blockers.issue: Slack App Directory review takes 8–10 weeks; any modification of scopes after submission immediately kicks your app to the back of the review queue.
blockers.workaround: Plan your entire scope list ahead of time, or use Composio Managed Auth to connect users immediately without waiting out the review.

blockers.issue: Cannot enable public distribution until the app has been manually shared and active in 5+ distinct workspaces.
blockers.workaround: Use direct install links with friendly beta testers before submitting to the directory.

composio.recommendation: Slack's 10-week public directory review and workspace distribution prerequisite make it a prime candidate for Composio Managed Auth.

evidence.claim: Slack bot tokens work immediately in the home workspace; public distribution requires meeting Slack's directory criteria and a review. (Documented, not personally tested.)
evidence.label: SOURCED

evidence.claim: Slack documentation states that adding a scope after directory submission triggers a complete re-review that can take up to 10 weeks.
evidence.label: SOURCED
